title: Resource Planning Lead | INTEGRATED RESOURCE PLANNING (IRP)
description:

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

Are you ready to help shape the future of the electric grid? Join American Electric Power's Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) organization and lead the development of long\-term resource strategies that support reliability, affordability, economic development, and the energy transition across multiple states and regulatory jurisdictions.
  

  

As a Resource Planning Lead, you will serve as a strategic leader and subject matter expert responsible for managing Integrated Resource Plans (IRPs), evaluating future resource needs, and assessing generation, storage, transmission, demand\-side, and emerging technology alternatives. Your work will directly support major investment decisions, regulatory filings, corporate strategy, and long\-term planning efforts that impact millions of customers.
  

  

This role combines project leadership, quantitative analysis, regulatory engagement, and cross\-functional collaboration. You will coordinate teams of analysts and subject matter experts, oversee complex modeling studies, develop planning assumptions, support regulatory proceedings, and provide technical guidance to senior leadership. If you are passionate about energy policy, utility strategy, generation planning, and solving complex challenges facing the power industry, this role offers an opportunity to make a lasting impact.**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

  

As a Resource Planning Lead, you will manage the planning activities that support AEP's regulated operating companies and long\-term generation portfolio strategy. You will be responsible for coordinating the development of Integrated Resource Plans and related studies while ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and evolving market conditions.

title: Manager, Engineering (Power Generation & Utilities) - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



We are looking for a Manager of Engineering to own the design, build\-out, commissioning, and continuous improvement of automation, controls, and electrical systems at SpaceX's power generation facility in Southaven. This plant is critical infrastructure for SpaceX's AI supercomputers: it must deliver high\-reliability power and supporting utilities at scale, with the uptime and response expected of a mission\-critical compute campus.



If it has a gas or steam turbine control system, a switchgear lineup, a plant electrical distribution network, a SCADA/DCS point, a control loop, or a supporting utility/process system (water, wastewater, fuel gas, HVAC, cooling) that must run reliably, this team designs it, specifies it, commissions it, and keeps it running. As a Manager, you will lead a team of engineers in a high\-reliability, fast\-paced environment. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role — you will review P\&IDs, challenge control philosophies, dive into DCS/PLC architecture, electrical protection schemes, and commissioning details, not just manage a roadmap. You will scale both the team and the systems as generation capacity and AI compute load grow.

description:

Through continuous technical innovation and standardization, they enable CoreWeave to rapidly and reliably scale its physical footprint to meet global infrastructure demands.

This role will primarily focus on managing the execution of Architectural, MEP, and LV/IT infrastructure designs within our leased data center facilities. The Sr. Data Center Design Manager will ensure that all designs align with our project requirements and are executed to meet performance, efficiency, and scalability standards.
